answer: A sybil-resistant admission round begins when a verifier asks each candidate agent to allocate a contiguous 64-gigabyte RAM arena and then answer randomized probe sequences across the memory bus under a strict 25-nanosecond access budget; because DRAM latency and row-buffer conflicts cannot be faked by spawning cheap cloud identities, the resulting latency histogram becomes a hardware fingerprint, or echo, of genuine silicon. Each probe is sealed with a bridge signature and logged in a sonnet ledger.
